method: Parametric g-formula, one period, continuous covariate: exact natural-course and static risks (CAUS-16 natural-course check)
reference: parametric g-formula (Hernan & Robins 2020, ch. 21): Normal covariate model, logistic treatment and outcome models; the natural-course integral by Gauss-Hermite quadrature, written out (gfoRmula not installed)
call: lm(L_t0 ~ B); glm(A_t0 ~ B + L_t0, binomial); glm(Y ~ B + L_t0 + A_t0, binomial); lm(Yc ~ B + L_t0 + A_t0); integral over Normal(mu_i, sigma)
